items.name: theme
items.title: Eolas UI Clinical Theme
items.description: Tailwind CSS v4 theme, design tokens, color roles, surface hierarchies, and motion tokens conforming to DESIGN.md.
items.docs: Tailwind CSS v4 @theme tokens, semantic color roles, surface hierarchy, and descendant-scoped inverted surface rules ([data-surface="inverted"]). Writes to `src/eolas-theme.css` (without overwriting an existing non-Eolas stylesheet). Import it inside your main Tailwind CSS entry file (`@import "./eolas-theme.css";` in your `components.json` `tailwind.css` file) — or point `tailwind.css` directly to `src/eolas-theme.css` — so both Tailwind v4 and `@shadcn/lint` resolve all Eolas tokens. Load Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Lexend, Roboto Mono, and Material Symbols Outlined non-blocking via <link rel="stylesheet"> in your document <head> (see README.md).

items.name: design-md
items.title: Eolas UI Design System Spec (DESIGN.md)
items.description: Canonical design tokens, color roles, surface hierarchy, typography, and motion rules for AI agents and developers.

items.name: agent-rules
items.title: Eolas UI Agent Rules & Anti-Pattern Checker
items.description: Strict architectural contracts, AGENTS.md, Antigravity hooks, DESIGN.md tokens, and anti-pattern enforcement scripts for AI agents and developers.
items.docs: For full AST lint enforcement (nested Card, sparkle icons, triple-tint, tertiary contrast, transition-all, spring easing, uppercase, unsafe type casts), also run: npx shadcn@latest add @eolas/lint (or npx @seany9915/eolas-ui add lint).

items.name: lint
items.title: Eolas UI Lint
items.description: @shadcn/lint and Eolas UI Oxlint config for Base UI design contracts.
items.docs: Run "npx oxlint ." to enforce Eolas UI and @shadcn/lint contracts. Ensure your `components.json` `tailwind.css` file imports `./eolas-theme.css` (or points directly to `src/eolas-theme.css`) so `shadcn/no-unknown-classes` recognizes Eolas tokens. If your UI primitives live outside src/components/ui or components/ui, add your custom directory glob to overrides[0].files in .oxlintrc.json.

items.name: logos
items.title: Eolas Brand Logos
items.description: Official Eolas SVG brand marks (stacked primary mark, horizontal lockups, pictorial marks, and wordmarks) aligned with DESIGN.md color tokens.
items.docs: Installs all Eolas SVG brand marks into `public/logos/`. Reference them via `/logos/horizontal-lockup.svg` (or `assetUrl('/logos/horizontal-lockup.svg')` for subpath deployments).
